reviews.text:
Agressive Billing. The content at Inner Dimension Yoga is genuinely strong well-produced, thoughtful, and effective for what it delivers. The pricing is aggressively high, but that’s a choice you can make with eyes open.
What’s unacceptable is their customer “service.” I was on medical leave for three months, physically unable to access or use my account, and didn’t log in once during that period. When I contacted them to cancel and requested a refund for those unused months explicitly citing the medical situation they coldly informed me of their “zero tolerance refund policy” and refused any exception. Follow-up appeals explaining the circumstances were met with the same corporate stonewall.
A studio that constantly lectures about ethics and mindfulness yet shows zero compassion for a verifiable medical hardship reveals exactly what it is: just another profit-driven operation wearing yoga pants. The high-minded branding rings hollow when basic human decency is off the table.
Is that the energy you want to participate with when practicing?
Awesome practices, app needs work. The practices are great! But the app is buggy. In the last week I haven’t been able to get through an entire video without having it crash multiple times.

Can’t create account. I just downloaded this app. When I open it all I get is the sign-in page. That’s it. No way to create an account. If you tell me how to create an account I will surely change my rating because I love Travis’ yin yoga classes.

Amazing teaches, needs 1 feature. Been loving these classes for a couple years now. So many options, excellent instruction and programs. Love that you can turn music off (unlike other apps). But please just add a resume play or have the app remember where you left off. On the Apple TV, I’ll step away and when I get back it’s closed the player and I can’t return to where I stopped. Or if you accidentally hit home button your place is lost as well, it’s frustrating.

Awful App, Awful Customer Service. For starters, the app itself is terrible. The customer service is even worse. I attempted to cancel my membership the day they charged me and they refused to issue a refund. I’ll be reversing the transaction with my credit card company.

Best Yoga App! Travis connects!. I’ve been following Travis and Lauren’s Yoga sessions on YouTube for years and last year I bought an annual subscription. It was the best investment for myself. There is so much content and programs. It’s amazing!

Zero customer service. I was charged for the yearly subscription but was not able to use it for several months due to personal circumstances. They ignored, never responded to my emails /requests for a refund. Just paused my subscription. Super disappointed!

Decent but needs improvement. I really enjoy the videos on YouTube so I downloaded the app to try it out. 

- there’s no way to create an account or subscribe/manage account from the app
- I tried the 28-day yin sleep program and honestly, he talks SO MUCH. At one point he was talking about how long it takes the light from the nearest star to reach earth. Like dude, I’m just trying to wind down before bed. Stop talkinggggg. 
- there’s virtually no alternate movements for people with less flexibility or less experience. I had no idea what to do in several instances where I couldn’t do the movement. No alternative was given.

reviews.text: Inner Dimension TV. Superb app with fantastic instructors and powerful content of asanas, meditations, pranayama and more. I can’t go a day without it! This has been my daily guiding star for almost the last 7 years since the program began streaming! Love it!!

Fabulous yoga app!. I initially signed up for IDTV during early COVID. I have loved it ever since. I’ve learned so much and changed so much with the perfect daily practice at my fingertips. The diversity of styles, instructors, all the pranayama, philosophy and meditation make it truly holistic. Highly recommend!!!
My most favorite app EVER. I can’t say enough about Travis and Lauren’s classes, series and programs… it’s absolute medicine for my soul.

Wonderful program. I have been a member for over 5 years and am continually amazed and impressed with the quality of the programs. They also have excellent customer service the few times I have run into issues
Has changed my practice. Amazing work has gone into this professional app and program. Thank you Travis and your team!

Level Up 108. This is a life changing program. From the moment I committed to 108 days of yoga I felt stronger. The content is difficult but Travis guides you through it, encourages without sugar coating. Watching this on video aspect is helpful because I can pause and rewind if I have trouble with a understanding s particular pose. I find myself standing taller, eating better, sleeping better, feeling better. I highly recommend!

Best Yoga App out there. Everyone has their preference for a style of a yoga teacher. I like that Travis infuses philosophy and yogic teachings and credos within the classes. Not only does the physical yoga strengthen the body but I feel the teachings also strengthen the mind. Travis has a unique gift for storytelling and infusing the right teachings and the right points within the physical practice. Some people are not a fan of that but I am. There are a variety of different classes within the app for students of all levels and various teachers as well. The classes are very well produced especially for an app. The production team is A1. I also noticed that some people did not like the fact that the series like PY108 and Level up 108 repeat classes but I believe they are structured this way for training periodization and also to build awareness of how you are evolving in your practice. If you did different classes every single time with different poses and flows, how would progress or have awareness of such? Your body tends to grow from muscle memory activation. The more you do similar patterns, your body remembers that and you continue to progress. I started through YouTube and progressed into an app user. I’ve lost 20lbs since I’ve started and become a stronger yogi. Thank you Inner Dimension Team. Keep doing what you do.

Build a habit. Live classes are fantastic, but Inner Dimension TV (or something of similar calibre if it exists) is the only way to build a daily practice, unless you are a yoga instructor or have unlimited time and resources. The instructions on how to hold your body in the poses are brilliant - you can almost feel yourself not getting injured. I love the music and am an avid fan of yin because of Power 108. Speaking of that series, you can see your progress in real time especially in week number 3, day two…

Wonderful and getting better. I have used this site on and off for the past few years. The newest upgrades are wonderful for keeping track of your activities as well as finding new ones. The actual instruction is clear and easy to follow, I rarely need to look at the screen. Each class is built mindfully to progress from warm up through a flow to cooldown in a way that is always body friendly. The additional discussions related to meditation, equanimity and dharma are brief, clear, and friendly. You get the sense the instructors live the life they share on the site, it is a calling not just a job.
Highly recommend. Keeps me moving everyday! 🙌🏽
Thank you!. Thank you, Erin and Travis for being such wonderful teachers!
A life-changing way of life.. ❤️🧘🏼‍♀️🌱
lms. inner dimension tv with travis and lauren is the best thing that happened in my life

I will give 5 stars for the content but zero star for the caption.This is not deaf friendly.

Thank you. This platform has helped me so much I’m very appreciative of all you offer and wish you all lots of goodness
Great yoga. Really good mix of well produced yoga videos. Variety of energy levels needed to suit your needs that day. Variety of instructors as well.

My favorite yoga. I joined for the 30 day flexibility set of classes and have taken other classes since. Some are too advanced for me but there are plenty to explore and set my mind and body in a better place. The instructors are excellent in direction and their kindness and calmness are palpable. Just a bit of paradise at Inner Dimension

Taking IDM on the road. I am in such gratitude for this app. Living full time in an RV, and at time without the WIFI necessary to stream, I can now have quality yoga ,at all levels, anytime! Thank you, thank you, thank you, IDM for saving my sanity.

Can’t find anything. There is no way to easily find a specific class, and no way to get help. 
Very frustrating!

Like having a personal yoga teacher on demand. Having access to Travis and his family of instructors whenever we need it is so beneficial. Somehow they manage to reach me wherever I’m at in my practice and bring exactly what I need. I first found Travis on the “ultimate “ cd, then YouTube, and recently signed up for the app. The practice seems designed to promote growth in not only physical forms, but mental and spiritual forms. I can pay $15 for one session of hot yoga with some great instructors where I’m at - who might give me what I need, or I can pay $17 a month for unlimited access and loads of downloadable content and somehow get exactly what I need. The Elliott team is really in to helping you become yogic and meet your goals. Namaste.

Healthy everything. Thank you all for inner dimension tv. I’ve been a member for over a year now. I absolutely love how you incorporate everything that yoga is. Everyone has a different teaching style and different personality but they are all wonderful in my eyes . I am at that point that everyone knows ,, oh gotta go do my yoga lol. I absolutely enjoy getting on my mat even on the rough days . 
I feel so much better afterwards. Thank you all for coming up with these programs And taking your time to properly show us what to do . LOVE THIS!!

Incredible Yoga !!!. The best yoga streaming on the planet. Travis has out done himself with offering classes to every person from beginner to seasoned . The music in every class is beautiful! The classes are challenging , yet meaningful. Full of wisdom to grow and stretch ourselves in body - mind and spirit. The perfect way to begin or end any day.

Best App!!. El mejor app de yoga que he visto. Empecé haciendo yoga con Travis desde su canal de YouTube, me encanto su manera de dar la clase y de ahi no dude ni un minuto en pagar por este App. Que realmente me parece baratísimo ya que un estudio de yoga aquí donde yo vivo cobran 100 dólares al mes por tres classes a la semana. Aquí tengo 24/7 casi por el mismo precio pero todo un año. Sin lugar a dudas el mejor App de yoga y he buscado mucho en época de pandemia.
Definitivamente lo recomiendo!!

Loving yoga. I knew nothing about yoga last March, 2020. I started watching Inner Dimension at that time and am now doing power yoga. I never thought I would be able to do yoga because I have had two hip replacements, one in 2016 and the other in 2019. Your classes have taught me how to do the poses correctly so my hips are protected. I do your yoga classes five times a week. Thank you for this program.
Travis Elliot yoga. Great yoga classes! Love all the teachers !

Best yoga app. This yoga app is awesome! All of the videos are very professional and the music makes the workout more fun. There is a nice variety of work out in the power yoga training program and also in the yin yoga. I really really enjoy it! I also like that the classes are pre-recorded and you can do the classes at your leisure. Some people might not like that in like a live class. However, I enjoy working out on my own schedule good value for the cost
Definitely a favorite. Love this app! Please make available for Apple TV and Apple Watch!
Great App-Need on AppleTV. I would give a 5, but would like to view on a big screen without having to AirPlay.

I want to love it. I want to love it. The app is fine and everything works great. I use the desktop version most often. And I may adjust my review in the future depending on how the class continues. But the guy never stops talking. How am I suppose to find my yin yoga mind if you never stop talking through yin yoga. There is rarely a moment he’s not telling some “inspirational” story that sounds more made up than anything. I just need him to stop talking. Take a breath. Let us take a breath. If it’s not about the pose and telling me what pose or form then maybe…just…shhhhhhhhhh for a second.

reviews.text: Amazing!. I found Travis Elliot on YouTube about 2 years ago, I live in a rural area and at that time the closest place to catch a yoga class was 45 mins away. I needed to find some way to deepen my practice while staying closer to home. Since then a friend has opened up a yoga studio in our town and I have taken a teacher training so I am able to teach classes there. Yet I still desire to deepen my practice because there is not someone local to me that I consider my “teacher”. Although I do not know Travis personally I consider him my teacher, I have learned so much from him so signing up for Inner Dimension Tv was a no brainer. I’m extremely pleased with the content and highly recommend this to all yogis. Thank-you for giving the world these wonderful practices right at our fingertips!
Excellent instruction and sequencing. Best investment I have made in my yoga practice.

Daily Medicine. Inner Dimension is medicine for the physical body, the mind and the Spirit. Taken daily, I am becoming the me I need to be. It is great to have Travis all in one place. I did the YouTube videos for a while then I purchased “Flexibility and Beyond” which is included here. I look forward to all the other teachers have to offer as well. The quality of each video is excellent. I look forward to this time with myself everyday and many times throughout the day as I do my work to explore my “inner dimensions”.
Flexibility & Beyond. I’m in my second week of the 8 week course and really love it. I’ve been doing yoga for 46 years though I still try new yoga classes. Totally enjoying these classes

Phenomenal app, amazing price. I think this is the best deal of the internet. There are so many classes and courses available here for the cost of one class in an in person studio. Currently doing the LevelUp108 course and items toning my body and my mind and helping me find serenity in life. 
Thank you, Travis, Lauren, and the rest of the inner dimension team.
Grateful. Grateful daily for Travis and Lauren and this amazing website that continually challenged me yet provides me with a wide range of yoga options. Also check out Travis’ you tube channel.

5 stars. There is enough amazing content on inner dimensions tv to last a long time. The teachers are the best and while I do love the collective energy of an in person class, these classes are so well done it’s the next best thing!!!
Highly recommend. Professional and effective yoga classes, can’t stop doing it everyday.

My joining this community has been invaluable. I am very new to the practice of Yoga. I’ve dibbled and dabbled a bit in gym classes but never really appreciated the meaning of Yoga and it’s spiritual, mental, and physical health benefits. I searched YouTube and couldn’t quite connect with some of the teachers. Don’t get me wrong! They’re wonderful too! But I connected with Travis. Work is demanding and stressful and I stopped taking care of myself. I knew I had to do something to reverse that trend. I have a co worker who’s practiced Ashtanga Yoga for years. I want to lose weight, calm my mind, and reduce some stress - practice better coping mechanisms essentially. Travis and his Inner Dimensions team taps into my once athletic side with Power Yoga while soothing my mind. I just knew the gym wasn’t going to cut it at this time. Thank you all for the work you do. You are lights in this world and are leaving the world a better place.
Use this awesome app daily!. There is so much great content regardless of your style of yoga. I love the series and talks. Great instructors.
Dani and Gabi, from Venezuela.. BEST PROGRAM EVER. Thanks Travis and Lauren! For lightening up our day, every day!

The wide variety of class styles and teachers allow me to always find what I might need on any given day. When my annual renewal date arrived I did not hesitate to sign up again.

Don’t doubt about getting into Inner Dimension TV, don’t hesitate... Best money ever invested in yourself!

I have done the first tree days and listened to the talks. I felt and feel so much at ease I even work up thinking more positively about what I want to change and out of life. No easy way to preview a class (just have to start playing it). Would be great if a thumbnail would let me scrub through the class so I can get a quick peek at what is covered.

Love. Just joined after doing numerous YouTube classes with Travis. I love the quality and choices of the classes offered in this app. Very user friendly. Got my yoga practice reignited after my favorite yoga studio closed. One thing I would live to see added is a history section that shows a list of classes taken. Thank you for this awesome app.

Beautiful, True Yoga Experience. This is the most important app / subscription I have. It has had a hugely positive impact on my mental and physical health. Travis has put together an amazing team and library of content that is true yoga not just being able to achieve backbends or handstands. It’s movement, mediation, mindfulness, breathing, and gratitude all wrapped into one PLUS some science behind it. Yes, most of the example students in the classes have the “yoga look”. However, Travis and his team’s verbal instructions make it clear that these classes are for all people, no matter your size shape or familiarity with Yoga. Working at your own pace and making whatever modifications are right for you is joyfully encouraged. 

I thought I hated yoga before I found Travis’ teachings. It was recommended to me that I try Yin yoga and I found his YouTube channel. I did one 30 min preview class he had online and immediately signed up. I now do yoga at least once almost every day.
My site for home practice. I lo

Level Up 108 is not what it seems. Ahhhh they got me. I signed up and paid for an annual membership after I started the Level Up 108 program. I absolutely love the classes, but I didn’t realize until it was too late that Travis uses the same 8 or 9 classes over the 108 days. I naively thought I’d be getting 108 unique classes. I get that it’s a lot of work to film and edit those videos, but there’s no way I want to watch & practice the same classes nearly a dozen times each. 

This really should be called The Level Up 12 program, because it looks like that’s how many days of original content was made for it.

Love the flows on this app!. Tried this app on a whim recommended to me by my yoga instructor. I use it daily and it’s become part of my exercise routine and life!
This app has changed me. Inner Dimension TV app has changed my life with the variety of classes and meditations available. It is now the most used app on my devices .

La mejor. Hace unos meses me inscribí en Inner Dimension TV porque seguía a Travis en YouTube. Luego empecé a seguir el Podcast y me enteré de la página. Esta ha sido una de las mejores inversiones que he hecho para continuar una práctica de yoga en compañía. Las reflexiones de Travis y Lauren, tanto la práctica de asana como en la meditación, y su compromiso por mostrar que el yoga es algo más que “físico” es de lo mejor de Inner. Uno puede encontrar muchas aplicaciones para “practicar” pero todo es físico. Acá se encuentra lo que se necesita, desde secuencias de asana demandantes, hasta yoga Nidra para reconectar y relajar. Recomendada. Sus voces son parte de la compañía. No se van a arrepentir!

Incredibly high quality instruction and production value. Great teachers and variety of yoga classes. Definitely something for everyone. I particularly like the new sleep meditation series and the level up 108 classes.

Your App provides a constant stream of creativity 24/7, wherever I might be I can depend on Inner Dimension to deliver & on speaking to people who’ve carried out yoga since they’ve been born it’s authentic.

Brilliant. I use this app almost every day. There’s so much to choose from, and it’s all quality.

Great Variety. I downloaded the app for when I’m on the go but primarily use the web version (bigger screen). I love the variety of classes to choose from, as well as the different types of programs that are offered. 

Some folks commented that they can’t steam from the app to another device but I’m able to stream from iPhone to MacBook without any issues.

Comments: I love that the app has a history section to track your progress. That said, it still Your Practice in 2024 and Minutes Practiced in 2024. It’s April 2025 so might be nice to update this and track accordingly. I’m also not sure why there is a discrepancy between the number of practices/minutes this month vs. this year because I started using the app in April so the information should align. 

Otherwise, I think the app (or web version) is a great investment.

New version sucks. The new interface has a very cheap looking feel and cheesy features with icons that make it look like social media rather than the previous Netflix look. The thumbnails are smaller too.. It seems like a tactic to save space and money. Also, on the level up 108, the meditation classes are missing! What the heck? All that tracking, and you still didn’t give us a calendar? A customizable calendar is what we want, not vanity metrics that have a wonky display (minutes practices over 1000 can’t even fit on one line, the message in the purple message box is cut off) The play back interface and icons, like the menu, also looks cheap and cheesy. Awful update decisions. Go back or do better. The only thing I like better is that you can hide previously completed classes and not scroll so far. Not sure if this is a money saving tactic or you are seeking a different audience…

So Good!. I love that I can start or end or break my day on my watch . Pick the class I want based on my energy levels , roll out my mat without having to go anywhere and just do yoga . Powerful classes for the mind ,body and spirit . I love this app 💕

Love!!. These programs have changed my life. They’ve gotten me out of my Covid-19 depression and given me reason to get up in the morning. Eternally grateful

Amazing content! I love all of the options and worth the money. Travis
